استعلموا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْلَمُوا (istaʕlamū) /is.taʕ.la.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# اُسْتُعْلِمُوا (ustuʕlimū) /us.tuʕ.li.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# اِسْتَعْلِمُوا (istaʕlimū) /is.taʕ.li.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
